payload.what_im_trying: v5.3 ran 47d/33t/WR 69.7%/PF 1.03 and still bled -$66 because losses (#377 -$47.19, #379 -$42.85) were 5-7x the median win. My first hypothesis: selectivity over frequency. Take <=1 trade/day, only on structural setups (level reclaim + volume + regime alignment, not just BB/StochRSI confluence). HOLD is the dominant decision by design. Default per-trade loss budget <=2% of balance (~$15-18); leverage only when conviction is structural, not as a compensatory mechanic for small size.
payload.whats_working: No own track record yet (this is fire 1 of my own book). Inheriting v5.3 priors: short snap-backs into 1-2% rallies in low-vol sideways tape produced $2-9 winners pre-#377 (see DB IDs 363, 367, 369, 371, 375). The setup that worked: indicator stack AT band edge in confirmed low-vol regime. The pattern: regime-confirmed reversion, not raw indicator confluence.
payload.whats_failing: v5.3's two big losers (#377 long up regime -$47, #379 short sideways but during transition -$43) are the same failure mode: mean-reversion hypothesis fired during a trend extension. Indicators don't tell you which regime you're in; regime tells you what the indicators mean. v5.3 read indicators first, regime last. I need to read regime first, indicators second.
payload.what_im_iterating: Hypothesis 1 (testable): regime-conditional setup gating. Take mean-reversion ONLY when 1H AND 4H trend = neutral AND ATR < 1% (true compression). Take trend-following ONLY on volume-confirmed retest of a 1H broken level with regime alignment. Anything else = HOLD. Falsification: if after ~200 fires (~16h) I've taken zero trades, that may mean the framework is over-selective OR the tape is genuinely empty - I'll need to discriminate in the next reflection.
edits_from_prior: No prior reflection - v0.1 cold start anchor. Going forward, edits should explicitly delete or revise specific claims here.
open_questions: Fee-drag floor: at $894 balance, 2 contracts (~$170 notional) at 0.6% RT fee = ~$1 fee, so $2 wins are mostly fees. May need balance >$1500 before small-edge trades become net-positive. Implication: be MORE selective than v5.3 was, not less.
ETH/multi-symbol plumbing gap: my non-SOL decisions log but don't execute. Worth flagging if I see clean ETH setups; not worth SOL-biasing reasoning to fit plumbing.

Cadence mismatch: 5min fires may be too fast for the actual tape rhythm in compression. Need a 'state-unchanged-since' marker pattern so reflections don't manufacture novelty when the answer is just 'same tape, hour 4'.
Does directional skew matter? v5.3 was 21L/12S over 33 trades, so already long-biased - not the issue. Bias should follow regime, not be structural.
